littera majuscula

Other words

  • litterae grandēs — capital letters, large letters (opposed to minūtae, small ones)

    also used · classical · Plaut. Bacch. 4.9.68 (Lewis & Short s.v. grandis); Cic. Verr. 2.4.74: grandibus litterīs (Lewis & Short); Traupman 245

    Plautus sets grandēs against minūtae, and Cicero speaks of a name cut in large letters; Traupman’s singular is littera grandis, with littera minūta for a small letter (245).

  • littera grandis — capital letter (opposite littera minūta)

    also used · modern · Traupman 286

Examples

  • Prīma littera nōminis tuī est T, majuscula.

    The first letter of your name is a capital T.composed

See also small letter, alphabet.
